schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Internal packages are workspace links, not registry deps.
One PR for the whole toolchain. These move together and a repo where eslint and typescript-eslint disagree on a major does not lint at all.
Nest ships @nestjs/* in lockstep; a partial bump is a broken DI container.
React and its types and its DOM renderer are one decision.
Prisma's CLI and client must be the same version or `generate` produces a client the CLI cannot migrate against.
Patches and minors for everything else, batched weekly. Majors stay one PR each — they are the ones worth reading.
Node stays on whatever .nvmrc says; bumping the runtime is a deliberate act, not a dependency update.
